privacy.intro: Christmas Studio does not require registration. This policy explains what data is stored in your browser and processed when you visit the site, when analytics is used, or when you contact its creator.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.description: The data controller is {ownerName}. For privacy enquiries, contact <emailLink/>.

localData.title: 2. Data in your browser
localData.intro: Projects and exported files are created on your device. Your designs are not sent to the creator or a server. Your browser’s localStorage stores:
localData.projects: One Advent tag project and one card project, including their names, identifiers, text, appearance and element order. Any personal information you enter in a design also remains part of that project.
localData.recovery: A technical copy of a damaged project for recovery, and your recently selected colours.
localData.preferences: Records of notifications and the guided tour being shown, and the version and time of your acceptance of the terms.
localData.retention: These records preserve your work and settings. They have no automatic expiry date. After confirmation, a new project replaces the current project in the selected editor; the recovery copy and service preferences may remain separately. To delete all records, clear this site’s data in your browser settings. The creator cannot access these records. Undo and redo history is lost when the page reloads.
localData.noTracking: The app does not set its own cookies or use localStorage or sessionStorage for analytics. Accepting the terms does not constitute consent to analytics, advertising or tracking.

analytics.title: 3. Usage analytics
analytics.purpose: To understand which features are useful and improve the studio, the creator uses PostHog Cloud EU in cookieless mode. The only events counted are opens of the Advent tag editor, card editor and gift catalogue, and successful PDF downloads of tags, cards or a gift list.
analytics.data: An event contains its name, time, a random event identifier and the site host name. When receiving the request, PostHog technically uses the IP address and browser user agent to create an irreversible identifier that changes every day; the IP address is removed before the event is stored. This allows visits to be counted within one day without a persistent user identifier.
analytics.excluded: Automatic pageview and click capture, user profiles, session recordings, heatmaps, surveys, error reports and performance metrics are disabled. Analytics events do not include the page path or query, referrer, the contents or settings of designs, text entered in a design, gifts, email addresses or other data entered in the studio.
analytics.provider: PostHog, Inc. (United States) processes the data as the analytics provider. The PostHog EU region is used, with storage in Germany. PostHog allows processing outside the EEA, including in the United States, and identifies the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and EU Standard Contractual Clauses as safeguards. Events are retained for no more than {analyticsRetentionMonths} months and are then removed during scheduled deletion. See the <privacyLink>PostHog privacy policy</privacyLink> and <docsLink>privacy documentation</docsLink> for details.

hosting.title: 4. Hosting and file loading
hosting.github: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub logs visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes, whether or not they have an account. See the <link>GitHub Pages documentation</link> for details.
hosting.githubPolicy: The processing of technical data, recipients, retention periods and international transfers, including to the United States, are described in <link>GitHub’s privacy statement</link>. The creator does not receive logs of visitors’ IP addresses.
hosting.localAssets: Fonts, images and libraries are loaded from this site. No external CDNs or Google Fonts are used. PDF, PNG, JPG and ZIP exports are created in your browser.

contact.title: 5. Contacting the creator
contact.email: You send emails yourself using your email app. The creator receives your email address, message and any name or attachments you provide. Gmail is used to reply; the processing and international transfer of emails are described in <link>Google’s privacy policy</link>.
contact.feedback: The “Leave feedback” button opens Google Forms in a new tab. The creator does not receive your answers until you submit the form. After submission, the creator receives the information you entered; Google may also process account information, an email address, an IP address, and browser or device information depending on the form settings and how you open it. Responses are used to review feedback and improve the studio, then deleted or anonymised once those purposes have been fulfilled, unless longer retention is required by law or to resolve a dispute. Google’s processing, including possible international transfers, is described in <link>Google’s privacy policy</link>.
contact.retention: Correspondence is used to respond to your enquiry and is deleted within {correspondenceRetentionMonths} months after the enquiry is closed, unless retention is required by law or to resolve a dispute. No marketing emails are sent.
contact.report: The technical report in Help contains the app version, browser information, save status and the number of errors and warnings. Project content is not automatically included. You add the problem description yourself; copying the report does not send anything to the creator.
contact.issues: GitHub Issues is used separately and only for technical reports from the Help section. If you open it and submit a report, it may be publicly accessible. GitHub’s privacy policy applies on that platform.

processing.title: 6. Purposes and legal bases
processing.basis: Personal data needed to provide the requested editor features and fulfil the terms is processed under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Replies to general enquiries, protection of the site and minimal usage analytics are based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The creator’s legitimate interests are maintaining the service, responding to enquiries and understanding feature usage without creating persistent user profiles.
processing.optionalData: You do not need to provide personal information to use the editor. Your email address is needed only to reply to your email. Data is not sold or used for profiling or automated decisions with legal effects.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.requests: Where provided for by the GDPR, you may request access to your data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Contact <emailLink/> to exercise these rights.
rights.complaints: You may also lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority, including in the place where you live or work, or where an alleged infringement occurred. For data that GitHub and Google process for their own purposes, you may contact them directly.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

terms.intro: Christmas Studio is a free space for creating festive designs. Advent tag and card editors are available. The stickers and ideas sections are in development.

general.title: 1. General terms
general.access: The service is free. No registration, account, subscription or payment is required. Before creating your first project, you must read and accept these terms. The version of the terms and the time of acceptance are recorded only in your browser; this does not create an account.
general.changes: The creator may change features, add functionality and discontinue support for individual tools.

storage.title: 2. Saving designs and privacy
storage.privacy: You do not need to provide a name or email address to use the editor. Projects and their designs are stored locally in your browser using localStorage. The site does not send your designs to the creator or store them on a server.
storage.loss: The browser independently stores one current Advent tag project and one current card project. Creating a new project after confirmation replaces the project in the selected editor. Clearing site data deletes local records. PDF, PNG and JPG files preserve the finished design; multiple downloaded images are packaged in a ZIP file. Editable data remains in the browser. The service does not guarantee data retention after clearing browser data, switching devices or a storage failure.
storage.hosting: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which processes technical visit data under its hosting policies. Details about local records, enquiries and external services are provided in the <link>privacy policy</link>.

materials.title: 3. Use of materials
materials.intro: Illustrations, templates and decorative elements are intended for personal festive creations.
materials.personalDesigns: Create personal festive designs using the available tools.
materials.print: Download and print your finished designs.
materials.decoration: Decorate gifts, your home and personal celebrations.
materials.gifts: Give your creations to friends and family.
materials.commercialUse: Use the project’s materials or products based on them commercially.
materials.resale: Sell finished tags, cards, stickers or other products containing the project’s materials.
materials.redistribution: Sell, distribute or republish individual digital illustrations, backgrounds or templates.
materials.collections: Create and distribute digital collections, graphics packs or template sets using the project’s materials.
materials.authorship: Claim the project’s materials as your own original illustrations.
materials.scope: These are the rules for using materials within this project. They do not mean that every individual graphic element automatically carries exclusive copyright.

ai.title: 4. Artificial intelligence and third-party rights
ai.creation: The illustrations and graphics in this project were created using artificial intelligence. Their legal status depends on applicable law. The creator does not claim exclusive rights to fully generated images or guarantee that every element is unique.
ai.thirdPartyRights: Images may resemble results generated by other users of similar technologies. The use of AI does not in itself rule out third-party rights to individual elements, where such rights exist.

liability.title: 5. Liability
liability.availability: The service is provided “as is”. The creator aims to keep it running reliably but does not guarantee uninterrupted availability, freedom from errors or the preservation of data in your browser.
liability.userResponsibilities: You are responsible for the content of your own text and for respecting third-party rights when using your designs. Nothing in these terms limits rights that cannot be limited under applicable law.

changes.title: 6. Changes to these terms
changes.description: These terms may be updated as the project develops. The current version and update date are published on this page. When the version changes, the editor will ask you to review the updated terms before creating a new project.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.description: The project creator is {ownerName}. For questions about the studio or use of its materials, contact <emailLink/>.

postcardIdeas.title: More than cards
postcardIdeas.description: Cards can do more than carry warm wishes! With a little imagination, they can become home decorations, festive table details or useful accessories. Simply choose a suitable size in the editor, then add text or use just an illustration.

ribbon.title: Ribbon
ribbon.description: Thread the ribbon around your gift through the hole in the Advent tag. If the tag has no hole, simply tuck it under the ribbon.
ribbon.imageAlt: Advent tags attached to gifts with green and red ribbons.

twine.title: Twine
twine.description: Use natural or decorative twine instead of ribbon. This looks especially lovely with kraft paper and nature-inspired wrapping.
twine.imageAlt: Tags tied with twine to a gift box and a bag handle.

tape.title: Decorative tape
tape.description: Attach the Advent tag with decorative tape. Choose colours and patterns that match the illustration for a coordinated look.
tape.imageAlt: A snowman tag attached to a box with green tape patterned with Christmas trees.

waxSeal.title: A wax seal
waxSeal.description: A wax seal holds the Advent tag in place and gives your gift a touch of vintage charm.
waxSeal.imageAlt: A tag with a winter house secured with a red snowflake wax seal.

clothespin.title: A mini peg
clothespin.description: Attach an Advent tag without a hole to a ribbon using a small decorative peg.
clothespin.imageAlt: A round tag attached to velvet ribbon with a mini wooden peg.

clip.title: A clip
clip.description: Secure the Advent tag to the edge of a gift bag with a metal clip. A stylish detail that needs no extra holes or glue.
clip.imageAlt: A bullfinch tag attached to a gift bag with a gold-coloured clip.

corners.title: Decorative photo corners
corners.description: Stick small paper corners onto the box and slide the Advent tag into them. The neat result looks like a tiny picture frame.
corners.imageAlt: A fawn tag held in four gold-coloured photo corners on a gift box.

glue.title: Straight onto the wrapping
glue.description: Simply glue the Advent tag to the wrapping paper. Double-sided tape works too.
glue.imageAlt: A robin tag glued to kraft wrapping paper beside an evergreen sprig.

ring.title: A metal ring
ring.description: Thread a metal ring through the Advent tag’s hole and the gift bag’s handle to attach it like a keyring.
ring.imageAlt: A lantern tag hanging from a gift bag handle on a metal ring.

elastic.title: An elastic band
elastic.description: Stretch an elastic band around the gift and tuck the Advent tag underneath. This works especially well for bottles and other unusually shaped gifts.
elastic.imageAlt: An Advent tag held against a gift bottle by a red elastic band.

tagIdeas.title: Ways to attach Advent tags
tagIdeas.description: Advent tags do more than number your gifts — they are a lovely part of the festive wrapping. Attach them in different ways, combining ribbons, twine and other decorative details.

upload.question: Can I upload my own image?
upload.answer: Not in this version — only the built-in library is available. Image uploads may be added later.

tags.title: Create your Advent tag set in four steps

choose.title: Choose a template
choose.description: Choose one of the ready-made sets.

edit.title: Personalise your Advent tags
edit.description: Change text, fonts, colours and illustrations. Move and resize elements.

check.description: Browse the tags in your set and fix any errors. Red indicators mark empty or invalid fields.

download.description: Open the preview, download a PDF and print on A4 paper at 100% scale.

storage.answer: In this browser on this device. Clearing site data deletes the project; undo and redo history resets when you reload.

printSize.answer: Print the PDF on A4 at 100% scale with “Fit to page” turned off.

download.question: Why can’t I download the PDF?
download.answer: Red errors block downloads. Open the preview and select Fix next to the issue.

textOverflow.answer: Shorten the text, reduce the font size or widen the box. Text is not shrunk automatically.

cardCount.question: Can I change the number of tags?
cardCount.answer: Choose 24 or 31 tags when creating a set. To change the count later, create a new set.

import.question: Can I restore an editable project from a PDF?
import.answer: Import is not supported in this version. A PDF preserves the finished design for printing.

applyAll.question: How do I style all tags at once?
applyAll.answer: Select Entire set in the right panel, then change a setting. Afterwards, the editor switches back to the current tag.

save.answer: Check your browser’s site storage permissions and available space. Download a PDF before closing the page.

postcards.title: Create your cards in four steps

choose.title: Choose a format
choose.description: Start with a blank A6 or 105 × 105 mm square card. A project can contain 1–20 cards in different formats.

edit.title: Design your card
edit.description: In Text, enter your own words or choose ready-made lettering. Add illustrations and decorations, then adjust Background. Use Layers to change element order and locks.

check.description: Browse your cards and fix any errors. Before exporting, review the warnings: they do not block export, but highlight details that may affect print quality.

download.description: Save the current card as a PDF, JPG or PNG. Print at 100% scale.

storage.answer: In this browser on this device, separately from tags. Clearing site data deletes projects; they do not sync to other devices.

printSize.answer: A single-card PDF keeps its size; a project PDF arranges cards on A4. Print at 100% with “Fit to page” off.

download.question: Why can’t I download the file?
download.answer: Use Fix to resolve red errors. If only warnings remain, review them and confirm that you want to continue.

textOverflow.answer: Shorten the text, reduce the font size or widen the box. Fit box to text resizes the box without changing the font size.

lettering.question: How do I add ready-made lettering?
lettering.answer: Open Text, choose Add from library, then select Lettering. Its wording cannot be edited; choose Add text to write your own.

format.question: Where do I change the format and background?
format.answer: Change the selected card’s format in Cards and its background in Background. Review the layout after changing format.

layers.question: How do I manage layers?
layers.answer: In Layers, select, reorder, lock or delete elements. Unlock a locked element before editing it.

cardCount.question: How do I change the number of cards?
cardCount.answer: Add, duplicate or delete cards in the strip or Cards panel. Projects hold 1–20 cards; deletion can be undone.

import.question: Can I restore an editable project from a PDF or image?
import.answer: Import is not supported in this version. PDF, PNG and JPG preserve the finished design; the editable project stays in your browser.

applyAll.question: Can I apply a design to every card?
applyAll.answer: Cards are edited separately. Duplicate a card to reuse its design; editing the copy will not change the original.

save.answer: Check your browser’s site storage permissions and available space. Download a PDF, JPG or PNG before closing the page.

postcards.offer: Five quick tips will show you how to design cards, work with layers and save your creations for printing.

content.title: Create your card
content.edit: In the Text tab, choose Your text or Ready-made lettering. Add illustrations and decorations from their own tabs. Illustration search works in English and Russian.
content.move: Select an element on the canvas. Drag it with your mouse or finger, resize it using the handles and rotate it in 15° steps. Double-click to edit text.

background.title: Choose a background and format
background.edit: The Background tab offers ready-made images, solid colours and gradients. Background images fill the card and are cropped from the centre.
background.format: Changing the format in this tab affects only the current card. Element positions and sizes stay the same — review the design afterwards.

layers.title: Manage your layers
layers.actions: In Layers, select an element, move it up or down, lock it or delete it. Locked elements cannot be moved on the canvas.
layers.undo: You can undo each action. All cards in this project share one undo history.

cards.title: Build your project
cards.count: A project can contain 1–20 independent cards in different formats. The plus button lets you add a blank card or a copy of the current one.
cards.reorder: Drag thumbnails to change their order. The Cards panel offers the same actions as buttons — handy on a phone or when using a keyboard.

export.title: Review and save your designs
export.validation: In the preview, choose the current card or entire project, then PDF, PNG or JPG. Red errors must be fixed. You can acknowledge all warnings in one step.
export.formats: Your project is saved in this browser separately from Advent tags. PDF preserves physical dimensions; PNG and JPG images are prepared at 300 DPI. Multiple images download as a ZIP file.

tags.offer: Five quick tips will show you how to edit tags, change the whole set and prepare a PDF for printing.

content.title: Add text and images
content.edit: Choose Text or Image in the settings panel. You can change text content, font, size, colour and alignment. In Image, search by name or keyword in English or Russian and add an illustration to your tag.
content.move: Drag an element with your mouse or finger to move it. You can adjust the selected element’s size and position directly on the tag. Double-click text to edit it.

background.title: Style your background
background.edit: In Background, choose a colour or gradient for your tag. You can also add small decorations, such as circles or stars, and adjust their appearance and position.
background.mobile: On a phone, Text, Image and Background are in the bottom toolbar. Tap an icon to open its settings.

cards.title: Work with all your tags
cards.navigation: On a computer, switch tags using the strip at the bottom. On a phone, tap Tags in the bottom toolbar to open the list.
cards.applyAll: Style each tag separately or apply shared settings to the whole set using Entire set. Individual text and its position stay the same.

undo.title: Undo changes and try again
undo.description: If you do not like a change, use the undo and redo buttons in the top-right corner of the workspace. They let you undo or restore up to 15 recent actions.
undo.shortcuts: On a computer, use **Ctrl + Z** (**⌘ + Z** on Mac) to undo and **Ctrl + Shift + Z** (**⌘ + Shift + Z** on Mac) to redo. Changes are saved automatically in your browser. Your project remains after a reload, but the action history starts again.

export.title: Download and print your tags
export.open: When your designs are ready, click Export on a computer. On a tablet or phone, open the Export tab and go to the PDF preview. Review the arrangement of your tags on the A4 pages.
export.validation: Fix red errors before printing. Orange warnings do not block downloads, but are worth reviewing.
export.print: Print at **100%** scale and turn off “Fit to page” to preserve the correct tag dimensions. Then print the sheets and cut out the tags along the dotted lines.

common.availableLater: You can start creating straight away. The tour is always available in Help.
